stem: At Basalt Media, a global variable set defines `region` as us-east-1, and one workspace defines its own `region` as eu-west-1. An engineer runs a CLI-driven plan in that workspace and passes `-var region=ap-south-1`. Which value does the plan use?

choices.text: The value from the global variable set
The value defined in the workspace itself
The value typed on the command line
None of them; Terraform stops at a key that is defined in several places

rationale: Values given with -var or -var-file on the command line overwrite both workspace-specific variables and variable set variables that have the same key. Without a command-line value, the workspace-specific value would beat the variable set, so the global set loses in either case. Terraform does not reject a key defined in more than one place; it applies the precedence rules.
